Fresno State ranks 9th in the FBS averaging 35.2 penalty yards per game. Fresno State is 117th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 76.2% of trips. Boise State's red zone defense ranks 19th at 71.4%. Fresno State ranks 55th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 30:58, compared to Boise State's 1st-ranked average of 36:14. Team leaders Boise State Passing: Maddux Madsen, 1,058 yards, 11 TDs, 0 INTs, 65.9 completion percentage Rushing: Dylan Riley, 685 yards on 108 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Rasean Jones, 359 yards on 23 catches, 1 TD Fresno State Passing: Jayden Mandal, 1,034 yards, 6 TDs, 1 INT, 66.4 completion percentage Rushing: Rayshon Luke, 286 yards on 42 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Josiah Freeman, 322 yards on 25 catches, 2 TDs Last game Boise State defeated Utah State 37-18 on Oct. 3. Madsen led Boise State with 244 yards on 17-of-21 passing (81.0%) for two touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball seven times for 42 yards. Mandal led Fresno State with 245 yards on 24-of-33 passing (72.7%) for no touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball nine times for 27 yards. Luke had 46 rushing yards on six carries.
